design_status: Post-primary research design; prospectively frozen new economic confirmation. It does not replace the original policy/results or establish new Operational Alpha.
purpose: Test an explicit HOLD/continue-E alternative jointly with price and reserve before buying a merely feasible assessment.
original_data: economics/results/pilot_input.json and FREEZE.json; all prior results remain untouched
hold_semantics: Call the unchanged expert_E simulator, preserving every cost, production, prototype and reserve mechanism. Requested policy and actual operative policy are recorded separately. No assessment, retention or new Gym is bought by this mode; existing E continues.
assess_semantics: Call the unchanged requested optional policy, including its reachability-first screening and optional Gym logic. No gate or cost is modified.
control_semantics: U, E and equipped E+ retain their original simulator implementations and the same price/reserve grid.
selection: Evaluate all declared mode × price × reserve combinations on original development seeds1100–1131 only. Same objective0.5mean+0.5p10. Ties favor hold, then lower price ratio and lower reserve. Equal-content graph/library must select identically.
matched_diagnostic: Replay the unchanged original selected six policies on the same new tapes, without reoptimizing their price/reserve. Compare new selector minus old selector on each seed, profile and policy. This fresh matched diagnostic does not change original primary results.
evidence_limits: All enterprise quality extrapolation, markets, costs and money remain modeled exactly as in the original protocol. Improved controller behavior is conditional on those assumptions. Actual collections0; actual total cost and profit unknown. No restored historical profit or sustained compounding claim.
resource_equivalence: Same model assumptions,2recipient capacity, opportunity tapes, cost categories and native gate rules. Holding is an economic action, not permission bypass.
